name: Miranda de Ebro (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Miranda de Ebro (a castle between two eagles above waves on blue).
history: The oldest reference to the flag of Miranda de Ebro dates from between 1592 and 1614, in a municipal expenses book of that period; the flag was instituted officially on 24 March 1626, with Francisco Álvarez de los Ríos as corregidor of the city. It is a simple flag with a crimson taffeta ground (Pantone 200) bearing the arms of the city.
